description: Erection of a single storey rear infill extension and erection of a rear roof extension with two front roof windows to the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved drawings.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (007-A-11-00(B), 007-A-11-01(B), 007-A-11-02(B), 007-A-11-03(B), 007-A-17-01(B) and 007-A-17-02(B) [received 22/12/2020] and 007-A-00-00(B), 007-A-06-00(A), 007-A-07-00(A), 007-A-10-00(B), 007-A-10-01(B), 007-A-10-02(B), 007-A-10-03(B), 007-A-18-01(A), 007-A-19-01(B), 007-A-19-02(B), 007-A-08-01(B), 007-A-08-02(B), 007-A-08-03(B) and Design Statement [received 06/11/2020]) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The window(s) to be fitted on the front roof face of the dwelling shall be black-framed and traditional, conservation-style.

Condition : 5 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
